data.short_meaning: Ossuary, a limestone box for Jewish burial
data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'ossuarios' meaning 'a box for bones'. In the Jewish tradition, an ossuary is a limestone box used to store the remains of the deceased after the body has been buried. The name Usula can be seen as a reminder of the eternal nature of the human soul and the importance of preserving our loved ones' memories.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of eternal life and memory preservation.
